description: This file defines a utility class StringUtils with static methods for string processing, including delimiter replacement, markup-safe explode, and custom iterators. It also includes several helper classes for pattern replacement, iterators, and other string-related operations.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A collection of static methods for string manipulation.

classes.name: Replacer
classes.description: Base class for replacer objects used with pattern replacement functions.

classes.name: RegexlikeReplacer
classes.description: Replacer that substitutes regex matches with a string pattern.

classes.name: DoubleReplacer
classes.description: Performs secondary replacements within replacement strings.

classes.name: HashtableReplacer
classes.description: Performs replacements based on a lookup table.

classes.name: ReplacementArray
classes.description: A class that wraps an array for replacements, supporting lazy initialization and optional FSS resource fallback.

classes.name: ExplodeIterator
classes.description: An iterator for splitting strings by a delimiter without high memory overhead.

methods.name: hungryDelimiterReplace
methods.description: Replaces delimited substrings with a replacement string using an O(N) algorithm.

methods.name: delimiterReplaceCallback
methods.description: Replaces delimited substrings with a callback, supporting regex delimiters and flags.

methods.name: delimiterReplace
methods.description: Performs delimiter-based replacement using a callback, similar to preg_replace.

methods.name: explodeMarkup
methods.description: Splits a string by a separator while ignoring separators inside HTML-like tags.

methods.name: escapeRegexReplacement
methods.description: Escapes special characters for use in preg_replace replacement strings.

methods.name: explode
methods.description: Splits a string by a separator, returning an iterator that is memory efficient.
